charts.title: WASP-189 b: orbits around WASP-189
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-189's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-189 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ivshina & Winn 2022 (2022ApJS..259...62I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname IVSHINA__AMP__WINN_2022): P 2.7240308 d

charts.title: WASP-189 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-189 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (51) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 157910432, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 17 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min late; 17-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
